faq: How much traffic do I need for a test?
More traffic gives clearer answers. If your store has low traffic, we tell you before starting and pick bigger changes that show a result sooner, rather than tiny tweaks.
Which testing tool do you use?
We use what suits your platform and budget, often a free or low-cost tool or built-in theme tests. You see the monthly cost before we install anything.
Will you promise a winning result?
No. A test can show that a change helps, does nothing or hurts. All three are useful, because you learn what your shoppers respond to without changing the whole store.
Does the test slow down my store?
We pick lightweight methods and check speed before and after. If a tool adds noticeable delay, we change method.
